en.headline: Ramadan: plan it with your doctor
body: See your doctor 1 to 2 months before Ramadan.
Ask how to plan your meals and tablets.
When you break your fast, drink water and eat 1 or 2 dates.
Plain water is better than a sweet drink.
If you feel shaky, sweaty or confused, check your blood sugar at once.
en.passage: should see their doctor one to two months before the fasting month to plan their medicines and meals

ms.headline: Bulan puasa: rancang dengan doktor anda
body: Jumpa doktor anda 1 hingga 2 bulan sebelum bulan puasa.
Tanya cara merancang makanan dan ubat anda.
Berbuka dengan air kosong dan kurma.
Air kosong lebih baik daripada air manis.
Jika anda rasa menggigil, berpeluh atau keliru, periksa gula dalam darah anda segera.
ms.passage: should see their doctor one to two months before the fasting month to plan their medicines and meals

zh.headline: 斋戒月：先和医生一起计划
body: 斋戒月前1到2个月，先去看医生。
问问怎样安排饮食和吃药。
如果发抖、出汗或糊涂，马上验血糖。
zh.passage: should see their doctor one to two months before the fasting month to plan their medicines and meals
